text:
deploy-bot: Promotion job finished for billing-api chart@3.1.4 -> staging (promote=false). Post-deploy smoke failing 2/5 checks: DB-MIGRATION-LOCK, ENV_CHECK.
arun: saw the smoke failures too, look like a values overlay mismatch: migrations.enabled=false in merged values. staging should have migrations=true for the postdeploy job to run.
tess: that was unexpected — we didn't change migrations flag in this release. which overlay dropped it?
liam: quick values diff shows chart@3.1.4 introduces `migrations` at top-level; older releases had the key under `worker`. our overlay merger flattened it. diff snippet:
```
# staging merged values excerpt
migrations: false  # introduced by chart v3.1.4 defaults
worker:
  replicas: 2
```
ops-oncall: what's the blast radius? if migrations are skipped, schema changes won't apply; could break prod if promoted.
release-manager: pause automated promotions for this chart across all namespaces until we triage. also set a hold annotation so the next scheduled job doesn't bump it.
arun: suggestion: quick path -> patch staging HelmRelease values to explicitly set migrations: true (override), then re-run postdeploy smoke. alternative: rollback to chart@3.1.3 in staging. which is less risky?
tess: patching values is smaller surface area and fast. but we must record the reason in release notes and create proper revert later.
ci-bot: FYI release-notes check: release-notes present but missing migration note; lint ok.
liam: I'm +1 to patch staging override. command: `kubectl patch helmrelease billing-api -n staging --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/values/migrations","value":true}]'`
release-manager: let's do that, but run it as a dry apply first. also add a short hold annotation: `redwood.releases/hold=values-merge-migration`
arun: applying hold annotation and values patch now. running dry-run first:
```
kubectl get helmrelease billing-api -n staging -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'  # quick inspect
kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-api redwood.releases/hold=values-merge-migration --overwrite -n staging
kubectl patch helmrelease billing-api -n staging --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/values/migrations","value":true}]' --dry-run=client
```
ops-oncall: please also capture the current values-hash and chart digest in the rollout notes for traceability.
liam: grabbed them: values-hash: d9a7c8, chart-digest: sha256:aa11ff33
tess: after dry-run looks good. apply patch now.
arun: applied patch, re-triggering postdeploy smoke via `/deploy smoke billing-api staging`
deploy-bot: smoke trigger received. running checks.
ci-bot: note for release notes: add entry "migrations flag override added to staging due to values-merging change introduced by chart 3.1.4" and link to infra ticket.
release-manager: okay ops, monitor DB-migration job logs and make sure migration runs to completion. tag if anything blocks.
ops-oncall: initial migration job started, 20% complete, no errors yet. tailing logs.
liam: small follow-up: our overlay merger is doing a shallow merge; when chart authors move keys around it can silently change behavior. I'll open INFRA-2010 to track making the merger deep-merge by default for keys present in chart values schema.
tess: also update our release checklist to include a quick `helm template --values` validation against expected keys when chart bump PRs are merged.
arun: once migration completes and smoke green we'll remove the hold annotation and promote to canary (10%) in staging -> then back to normal cadence.
deploy-bot: smoke checks passed at 5602223600 (5/5). migration job finished successfully.
release-manager: remove hold and schedule a promoted canary run at 5602223700. remember to add a changelog entry: "chart 3.1.4 bumped; staging override applied to preserve migrations behavior; INFRA-2010 opened to improve overlay merge semantics"
liam: removed hold annotation: `kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-api redwood.releases/hold- -n staging`
arun: kicked promotion: `/deploy promote billing-api staging --canary 10`
ops-oncall: watching canary. if we see any errors related to schema or worker jobs raise immediately.
tess: creating the release notes PR now with the wording and linking INFRA-2010. pinging @release-manager for quick review.
ci-bot: release-notes PR created: https://git.redwood/infr/release-notes/pull/834
release-manager: LGTM, merging after 5m window. good catch everyone. follow-up infra ticket owner: @liam.
(END)
